steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 29
steps.text: In this B2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I read in my spare time.
I love sleeping in on weekends.
We made small talk while waiting for the elevator.

steps.text: It means: "To go to bed.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I'm exhausted, I'm going to hit the sack.
